trello.name: Renew and deploy wildcard SSL cert and rotate internal CA cert
trello.desc: Ben to renew the wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com (expires September 1st) and deploy it to the load balancers by August 22nd to allow buffer. Also rotate the internal CA cert that signs the service mesh, which expires two weeks after the public cert, in the same change window. Move both certs onto cert-manager so they auto-renew going forward.

trello.name: PDF export for reports
trello.desc: Aisha to implement the PDF export feature for reports as a single deliverable: backend renders the report to PDF using headless Chrome, and frontend adds the export button with a progress state for large reports. Record a short demo GIF for the marketing changelog as part of finishing the feature. Target completion is end of month.

trello.name: Staging parity
trello.desc: Ben to restore staging environment parity with production by running the three pending staging migrations today and writing a nightly job that diffs the staging schema against production and posts to the infra channel if they diverge.
